claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an LG flat-screen monitor and a full-size desktop keyboard on the desk.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen.
claims.evidence: Witness photo shows a dusty/marked screen but no powered-on test; dead pixels/lines require a screen test.
Witness report does not show a remote in the photos.
No internal/repair evidence or service history is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Monitor may not be working (backlight/graphics failure) or may have hidden screen defects not visible when off.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the monitor powered on showing a solid color test pattern (red/green/blue/white/black) and a desktop screen, plus brightness adjustment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly faulty (worst case: not working).

risks.risk: Dead pixels, lines, or burn-in may exist but are not testable from the off/dusty photo.
risks.proof: Close-up screen test while powered on: full-screen grid and solid colors, filmed at multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having potential display issues (worst case: dead pixels/lines).

risks.risk: Keyboard condition may be poor (missing/sticky keys, non-working keys) but cannot be confirmed without testing.
risks.proof: Video of the keyboard connected and typing in a text editor showing all keys respond (including function keys and number row).
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested keyboard (worst case: some keys not working).

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories/cables (power cable, HDMI/VGA cable, stand parts) could prevent use.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out: monitor power cable, signal cable (HDMI/VGA), and any stand/port covers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst case: buyer must source cables).

risks.risk: The two circular metal/black-ring items may be unrelated parts; if they are expected to be included, value changes.
risks.proof: A clear close-up identifying what the two circular items are (label/brand) and whether they are included with the monitor/keyboard sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price ignoring them as uncertain/unrelated items.

risks.risk: “Scrap” suggests unknown condition; there may be physical damage not visible on the front screen (ports/back casing).
risks.proof: Photos of the monitor back/ports and keyboard underside showing any cracks, bent pins, or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case cosmetic/port damage risk.

proof_requests: Power-on video of the LG monitor showing solid color test patterns and a desktop screen (no lines/dead pixels).
A close-up of the monitor ports/back panel and the keyboard ports/connection type.
Video showing the keyboard connected and typing with key response (all keys, including number row and function keys).
Photos/clip of all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI/VGA cable, stand parts, and confirm whether a remote is actually included).
Clear identification of the two circular metal/black-ring items (what they are and whether they are included).
response.reason: The witness confirms the presence of an LG monitor and a keyboard, but working/display quality and included accessories (especially the remote) cannot be verified from the off/dusty photos. Proof is needed to avoid overpaying for a potentially faulty or incomplete unit.
